verified_facts.text: The Grand Staircase is inspired by Besakih, the island's mother temple, and is a signature detail of 250 flights of stairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the island's mother temple, Besakih, the Grand Staircase is a signature detail of 250 flights of stairs.

verified_facts.text: The cliff suites and waterfall hill took inspiration from subak, the Balinese irrigation system, reflecting Bali's terraced paddy fields.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reflecting Bali's iconic terraced paddy field, the cliff suites and its waterfall hill took inspiration from subak, Balinese irrigation system.

verified_facts.text: The Pendopo Lobby has towering Gebyok partitions, each crafted by local artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the Pendopo Lobby, towering Gebyok partitions stand, each piece beautifully crafted by local artisans.

verified_facts.text: Every guest is welcomed by a personal dedicated concierge called the Lady in Red, who gives personalised recommendations on what to see and do in Bali.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lady In Red is your personal dedicated concierge. She knows everything about the city and can offer personalised recommendations on what to see and do in Bali.

verified_facts.text: The Cliff Lounge for suite guests is on the 9th and 10th floors of the cliff main building and has an infinity pool and a hydro jet pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: the lower level features a generous lounge area for leisure and business purpose, bar, infinity pool, and hydro jet pool.

verified_facts.text: Access to the Cliff Lounge is reserved exclusively for suite guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cliff Lounge access is reserved exclusively for suite guests staying at The Apurva Kempinski Bali

verified_facts.text: The main swimming pool is set amid tropical gardens with views of the Indian Ocean, and a children's pool is next to it.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set amidst tropical gardens with magnificent views of the Indian Ocean, our spectacular 60-metre swimming pool

verified_facts.text: Guests can use Nissan Kicks Hybrid and Nissan Leaf Electric vehicles to explore the Nusa Dua area, booked through the concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests who stay at the resort can use Nissan's Kicks Hybrid and Nissan Leaf Electric to explore the Nusa Dua area and adjacent attractions

verified_facts.text: The Spice Route Voyage takes guests aboard a handcrafted schooner phinisi through the waters of the Indonesian archipelago.
verified_facts.excerpt: the experience invites guests to traverse the historic waters of the Indonesian archipelago aboard a handcrafted schooner phinisi

verified_facts.text: The resort is in Sawangan, Nusa Dua, set apart from Bali's busier tourist areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: remaining a private, tranquil retreat set apart from Bali's busier tourist areas.

verified_facts.text: The Bali International Convention Center is listed as 5 km, about 10 minutes, from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bali International Convention Center 5 km 10 minutes

verified_facts.text: The Apurva Spa bases its treatments on Javanese healing wisdoms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Apurva Spa, where treatments are based on the Javanese healing wisdoms.

verified_facts.text: Bai Yun is a dim sum and hot pot restaurant at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dim sum and hot pot restaurant Bai Yun adds to the diversity of culinary offerings presented at the resort.
